text:
maria-infra: Heads up — new org bootstrap for AcmeAI. Need a compact, actionable checklist for cross-cloud account setup focused on GPU quota requests and network limits. Drafting here so eng + infra can pick owners.

Samir: +1, can we include region fallback guidance? some regions have ZERO A100 capacity.

Elaine P: Yes — also add tagging / billing mappings up front so chargebacks are clean. quick checklist idea below.

maria-infra: ok dropping draft checklist. keep it short for SRE handoff. please react with :eyes: if you can own a line.

maria-infra: Checklist (tri-cloud GPU + network focus):
- [ ] Org & projects: create org, seed billing accounts, one project per environment (dev/stage/prod). include project shortname pattern.
- [ ] Billing & quotas: link billing account, open quota requests for GPUs (acceleratorQuota / AWS "p4" estimates / Azure NCv3), attach expected usage numbers and timeframe. include target regions and fallback regions.
- [ ] IAM & service accounts: create cluster SA + infra SA, grant least-privilege roles, add org-level security group. document who can submit quota support cases.
- [ ] Tags & cost center labels: standardized label keys (team, env, cost_center, app); enforce via org policy or tag governance.
- [ ] Network primitives: VPC per environment, subnet sizing for node pools, private IPs for control plane, NAT/gateway, egress path and SNAT limits.
- [ ] LB & IP quotas: reserve static IP blocks for load balancers (verify regional L4/L7 quotas).
- [ ] IP address & ephemeral limits: request increase if > default ENI / ephemeral IP per-VM limit expected.
- [ ] K8s node pools & GPU quotas: plan node sizes (g4/p4/nd), request accelerators per-region, include accelerator family fallbacks (e.g., A100 -> A10G), and GPU quota increase justification text.
- [ ] Network throughput & NIC limits: raise NIC/ENI/sec or vCPU networking limits if running many pods per node.
- [ ] Private connectivity: if using VPC peering / Private Service Connect / ExpressRoute/Direct Connect, prebook and schedule provisioning windows.
- [ ] KMS & secrets: create customer KMS keys and service accounts, document HSM requirements if needed.
- [ ] Monitoring & alerts: enable quota alerting (80%/90%), node GPU exhaustion alerts, and health dashboards.
- [ ] Cost controls: plan committed discounts / reservations for expected baseline, and burst plan for spot/ondemand.

Samir: I can take "GPU quotas" line. want the exact support case copy we send — we should include sample text.

maria-infra: adding sample support blurb for quota increases:
```
Request: Increase regional accelerator quota for project X to support training/infra.
Project ID: proj-acmeai-prod
Accelerator type: nvidia-a100-80gb (or family: A100)
Requested region(s): us-west1, us-central1 (primary: us-west1), fallback: us-east4
Requested total GPUs: 40 (expected steady-state 24, burst 40)
Reason: Production inference + nightly large-batch fine-tuning. Provide commit on expected start date and per-week tokenization.
Contact: infra+quota@redwood.ai
```

Elaine P: Also include AWS example (short):
```
Service limit: GPU instances (p4d.24xlarge) - request 4 in us-west-2
Justification: inference pool for prod, expected sustained 2 instances, peak 4 for scheduled retrain windows.
```

Ira: For Azure we should request both vCPU and GPU quotas in same case; often they ask for vCPU headroom first.

infra-ops: FYI — network team flagged region us-central1 for private IP exhaustion last quarter. avoid making it primary unless we reserve additional subnet space.

kevin-cloud: I'll pre-check quotas across clouds and post current limits by EOD. tagging ownership: @Samir gpu quotas, @Elaine tags/billing, @Ira azure requests, @kevin-cloud network/reservations.

gcp-support-bot: Support case created: CASE-2026-3487 (accelerator quota increase) — expect 48-72 hours response.

Samir: can we include a short Terraform snippet for org policy to enforce tags? saves follow-up.

maria-infra: add small example in doc comments, but keep as optional.

deploy-bot: Reminder: schedule canary for first rollout AFTER quota confirmed and reserved IPs assigned.

Elaine P: I'll put checklist into our onboarding runbook and create a small PR linking the sample support case texts.

maria-infra: thanks team — action items: owners above, kevin posts current limits, Samir files quota cases with the sample text, Elaine updates runbook. closing thread when PR merged. :white_check_mark:
